name: stockflow-wms
description: A small warehouse management system: inbound stock, order reservation, picking and shipping.

scripts.setup: npm install && npm run db:push -w apps/api && npm run db:seed -w apps/api
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.start: npm run db:push -w apps/api && npm run db:seed -w apps/api && npm run start -w apps/api
